description: A scripted run of MCX.service through the whole loop: answers with memory, masking and the guard; feedback; gaps; a fix drafted from a gap, tested in a sandbox against the golden answers and evals, reviewed, signed off by the file's owner (not the author), deployed, and the question asked again; a manual change rejected; a field note from a down-vote; rollbacks; the daily cost cap; actions approved and rejected (human check) and written back (OPS.ACTION_LOG + outbox); audit verify; observe with drift; search, terms, graph, lineage, sources; export; retention purge. Run: node tools/scenario.js (compare) or --update (write evals/scenario-expected.json).

rules.clock: Step 1 runs at start; each next step one minute later; a step with "at" runs then, and the steps after it follow on from it. Every time read during one step is that step's time.
rules.ids: Fresh storage; ids from per-kind counters: log-0001, fb-0001, aud-0001, chg-0001, out-0001.
rules.args: Each step calls service[call](...args). A string "@name.path" is replaced by the value at path in the result of the step called name; a path segment [key=value] picks the first array element whose key equals value.
rules.results: ask results keep only the paths in askFields (a segment ending in [] maps over an array); other results are kept whole. Keys named ms are dropped. Errors are recorded as { status, error, code }.
